meta.name: Orbisfly Windch - 9m + 25cm Ball
meta.description: An Orbisfly Windch, a 9 m winch-suspended effect light with a 25 cm diffuse ball. A rectangular box, probably about 32 by 32 by 12.5 cm, forms the top, with the lift motor on its upper face. Below it, a short 5 cm stem and a flat disc of about 6.5 cm carry the sphere. The whole assembly pans a full 360 degrees about a vertical hinge at the top of the box, and the ball slides vertically on the winch over roughly 9 m. The front is one spherical diffuser with a single omnidirectional light at its centre, so the whole ball is one controllable cell. The hoist cable is not modelled.
